samples.name: construction-mine-1-ground
samples.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the mine reference to construction stage 1: Solid grey rocky slope with a small pale chalk arch marking where the entrance will be dug. Rock face is unbroken: no hole, no timber. Remove all carts, rails, tools, lanterns and stored goods. Keep exact rock outline, canvas, camera, base anchors and footprint from reference; no zoom or recenter. Simple chunky Kenney-like 48x48 logical pixel sprite enlarged with square solid pixels. Three flat shades per material maximum, grey rock and warm brown wood. No gradients, antialiasing, halo, glow, labels, lettering or scenery. Transparent outside rock, dark opaque interior when hole is present. Show all prior construction but none of later stages.
